purpose: A versioned acceptance plan, not executed application validation or deployment authority.

checks.criterion: Required configuration and referenced secrets are available before the first application process; an unavailable secret prevents process start.

TLS-only authenticated protocol succeeds without SNI; unauthorized clients and plaintext fail. Rotate server/client trust and credentials and verify both new success and revoked/old credential rejection within declared bounds.
Assert profile-owned key/value data before backup and after an explicitly authorized isolated restore. A Completed resource backup without volume or external-data coverage is insufficient.
Inventory and pin all install, upgrade-only, exporter, init, build and runtime dependencies. Disable external egress and exercise cold install, restart, upgrade and workload operations.
Run pinned YAML/schema tools and Helm lint/render for install and upgrade against target UDS capabilities; reject unsupported chart capabilities and undeclared upgrade images.

Emit zarf.yaml and a UDS Package CR with sso, allow and monitor sections; only operator-reviewed, evidence-backed not-applicable entries may be empty. Validate with pinned UDS schema and zarf dev lint.
Build exact package inputs in a separately authorized isolated environment; retain input/output digests and pinned tool versions. Export success alone is not an air-gap result.

Scan exact built digests under explicit operator-owned vulnerability, signature, dependency and license thresholds. Missing tools, unavailable databases, malformed scans and unverified provenance block admission.
Keep application and UDS Core versions separate. Require documented application upgrade steps and readiness; unknown migration/rollback semantics block. No platform upgrade is included in this trial.

Reject changed artifacts/config/target/profile/template, stale or replayed approval, forged summaries, cancellation and partial execution. No deployment is attempted when any required gate is failed or unknown.

existingEvidence.scope: Unsigned structural schema/Helm receipt for the narrow internal-stateless/v1 prototype. Its UDS schema pin is 9c808fd0af6bd0dca138da05f4a0d4785f109c32 and Zarf is v0.65.1; neither is silently substituted for the v1.15.0 held-out target.
Protocol/negative tests with explicit tool mocks; timeout/output bounds also exercise local processes. Not workload, cluster or air-gap receipts.
Evidence/configuration binding and fail-closed unsupported stateful capability tests. Valkey is outside the current internal-stateless/v1 generator.
Real Helm install/upgrade render boundary, including undeclared upgrade images. Does not establish generated application runtime correctness.

ownership.requiredTests: operator/profile-owned; generated artifacts cannot relax them
